faq.q: What is the best time for a sunset proposal in Marbella?
faq.a: Sunset in Marbella varies by season: summer (June-August) around 21:30-21:45, spring/autumn around 20:00-20:30. We recommend a 2-hour cruise starting 30 minutes before sunset to catch the golden hour and twilight. Your skipper will adjust timing based on the day.

faq.q: Which yacht is best for a romantic proposal?
faq.a: For intimate proposals, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (both 12.5m, up to 11 guests) are ideal at €749 for 2 hours. For a grand gesture, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) from €4,719 for 4 hours includes a jet ski and open-plan deck. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Can we bring our own decorations or photographer?
faq.a: Yes, you can bring decorations like flowers or banners. We recommend hiring a local photographer for candids; your skipper can suggest vendors. Champagne and rose petals can be pre-arranged via WhatsApp. Note that decorations must not damage the yacht.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). For proposals, we can add champagne, chocolates, or a custom playlist. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours.

faq.q: How do I book a sunset proposal charter?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp to request your preferred date, yacht, and any special requests. We'll confirm availability and send a payment link. A 50% deposit secures the booking. For 2031, we recommend booking 2-3 months in advance, especially for summer dates.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: Your safety is our priority. If the captain deems conditions unsafe, we'll reschedule your charter at no extra cost or offer a full refund. We monitor forecasts closely and will inform you 24-48 hours before departure. Sunset cruises are rarely cancelled in Marbella's stable climate.

faq.q: Can we anchor and swim during the cruise?
faq.a: Yes, most yachts allow swimming stops at calm spots like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Your skipper will choose a sheltered cove. Bring swimwear and towels. Note that sunset cruises focus on the golden hour; swimming is best done before the sun dips too low.

faq.q: Are children allowed on proposal cruises?
faq.a: Yes, children are welcome on all yachts. The Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 guests) or Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 guests) offer stable decks. Life jackets for all ages are provided. We recommend informing us of any children so the crew can prepare snacks and drinks.

data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella sunset cruise romantic proposal 2031? You've come to the right place. With golden light over the Mediterranean, the silhouette of La Concha mountain, and a glass of cava in hand, a private yacht charter from Puerto Banús sets the stage for a moment you'll both remember forever. Our fleet includes yachts from €749 for 2 hours, all with a licensed skipper, drinks, and snacks included. This guide covers everything: choosing the right boat, timing your sunset, arranging extras, and booking for 2031.

Why Choose a Marbella Sunset Cruise for a Proposal?

Marbella's coastline offers 27 km of scenic shoreline, from the Golden Mile to Cabopino. At sunset, the sky turns shades of orange and pink, reflecting off the water. A private yacht gives you total privacy—no crowds, no interruptions. You can propose on the bow with the wind in your hair, or on the flybridge with a backdrop of the setting sun. The warm Mediterranean climate means over 300 sunny days a year, so your chance of perfect weather is high. Plus, Puerto Banús is a world-class marina, adding a touch of glamour to your story.

Our Fleet for Romantic Proposals

We offer a range of yachts to suit different budgets and group sizes. All depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. See the table below for key options.

For intimate proposals, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are ideal. For a grand gesture, the Mangusta 80 includes a jet ski for free. All prices include VAT, skipper, and refreshments.

How to Plan Your Sunset Proposal

Here’s a step-by-step guide to ensure everything runs smoothly.

  • Choose your date: Sunset times in Marbella range from 18:00 in December to 21:45 in June. Book 2-3 months ahead for summer 2031.
  • Select your yacht: For 2-9 guests, the Astondoa 40 at €749/2h is perfect. For larger groups, consider the Azimut 39 or Mangusta 80.
  • Arrange extras: Add champagne, roses, a photographer, or a custom playlist via WhatsApp. Prices vary—ask for a quote.
  • Plan the route: Your skipper will suggest a route past the Golden Mile, toward Cala del Faro or Cabopino, anchoring for the sunset.
  • Propose at golden hour: Time your question for the last 20 minutes of sunlight when the sky is most colourful.

What’s Included in Every Charter

All our charters come with the following inclusions, so you don't need to worry about hidden costs.

  • Licensed skipper (speaks English and Spanish)
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (e.g., olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) included in the price

Popular Sunset Routes from Puerto Banús

Your skipper will tailor the route to your preferences, but here are three classic options.

  • Golden Mile Cruise: Head east along the coast, passing Marbella Marina and the luxury villas of the Golden Mile. Anchor near Cala del Faro for a secluded sunset.
  • Cabopino Escape: Sail west toward Cabopino, a quiet beach with dunes. The sunset view over the Sierra Blanca mountains is stunning.
  • Estepona Sunset: For a longer cruise, go south to Estepona, passing the cliffs of Cala Cortés. This route is best for a 4-hour charter.

Booking Your 2031 Proposal: What to Know

For 2031, we recommend booking by early 2031 for summer dates. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, yacht, and any extras. We'll confirm availability and send a payment link. A 50% deposit secures the booking; the balance is due 7 days before departure. Cancellations made 14+ days in advance receive a full refund. For last-minute bookings, we can often accommodate within 48 hours.
